rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0001
rows.name:
Before we leave, there's something I
need to explain to Hana and Boss, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0002
rows.name: What is it, mo?

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0003
rows.name: There's a gaming device here, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0004
rows.name:
I've been wondering about it for a
while. So it was a gaming device.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0005
rows.name:
That's right, mo! It's called
TIGER! TIGER!, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0006
rows.name:
It's a timeless masterpiece Grampypon
made for Tora when he was little, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0007
rows.name: Although it looks quite beat-up...

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0008
rows.name:
I switched it on earlier, so now
it's ready to play, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0009
rows.name: Boss! Give it a try, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0010
rows.name: Hmmmm...

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0011
rows.name:
I'd like to, but I might get too
absorbed in it, and we need to help
Nia...

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0012
rows.name: No, no, wait, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0013
rows.name:
You can get parts to upgrade Hana
by playing this game, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0014
rows.name: Is that so, mo?

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0015
rows.name:
Grampypon made this game knowing this
day would come eventually, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0016
rows.name:
If you ever think, "Hana's a little
weak! I want to make her stronger!"
then get parts here, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0017
rows.name:
Ah, I understand. In that
case, I'll give it one try.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0018
rows.name: That's a good idea, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0019
rows.name: Then let's TIGER! TIGER!, mo!

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0020
rows.name:
Since Boss is a beginner, let
me explain how to play...

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0021
rows.name:
Use the directional pad to move.
Press A to attack, mo.

rows.label: fev02_290_123_msg0022
rows.name:
As for the rest... explaining it is a
pain, so learn by playing, mo!
